reviews.comment: good prof, notes were super helpful, quizzes were online and the exams were just like the lecture/practice exams
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: class is difficult but his exams are pretty straight forward as long as you do the notes and hw. quizzes are online and not proctored. final isn't cumulative which helps a lot. prof is also a lenient grader. overall a nice professor unless you ask a stupid question in class (he will judge you).

A weed-out math class for engineers. Jinmin is good, but class gets tough. It starts off super easy, then gets really hard for the final. The exams are not common like 151 and 152, and the final is over a single "cumulative" chapter. 2 or 3 webassign hmwks due every week plus 1 take-home quiz due every Friday. If you have Jinmin, just keep him.

When it comes to you grade, do not expect to get any help whatsoever. His lectures are okay but I sometimes had difficulty understanding him and he often skipped steps that were important. The tests took a lot of effort to study for.
Bad lecturer, and his quizzes are complicated.

Professor Wang gives his lectures at lightning speed, and along with his very heavy accent made it hard to understand him many times during lectures. I only needed 3 extra points on the final to pass the class, but he denied my request to look over the exam to see if I could earn any points back. He also ignored Rev's Barks in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are fine overall, but he does skip a few unimportant steps that may make some of his "baby proofs" hard to follow. Otherwise, I've had no frustrations with him and his class was as simple as doing the work, attending class, and studying for the test.

Lectures are a little bland and difficult to follow at times, but if you pay attention you'll be fine. Biggest advantage to taking Mr. Wang is he's a lenient grader. Tests are pretty fair, but he changed the exam format a couple of times which was annoying. Overall, the minor inconveniences are worth it to likely be graded easier.

Prof Wang definitely has a bit of an accent, but it is still totally intelligible. I can tell that he cares about the ppl in his class and he is pretty good at explaining the calculus concepts. Some topics have been a struggle, but I recommend Houston Math Prep on YT in case Jinmin didn't do well explaining in class
Not much to say about him except for extremely average. Can be hard to understand him and what he's doing, but the course can easily be learned from youtube videos

Dr. Wang is amazing. He has a very deep understanding of the material, and it shows in his engaging lectures. He does work a bit fast, so read the textbook before class and review identities/formulas to follow along easier. He's hilarious, and clearly cares about the success of his students. He grades leniently, and gives detailed exam reviews.

Prof. Wang was truly awful. If someone asked a question, he would be rude and ask them how they didn't get it. He is very hard to understand, and instead of teaching, he solves the examples in his notes without saying anything. His handwriting is not legible, so you can't even read the problems he's working out. Take a different professor please.

Seemed like a very nice person, but lectures were extremely rushed and posted notes/youtube were much more helpful for learning content compared to lectures. Exams were ok. Contacted him through email and canvas about 3 times with follow-ups throughout the course of the semester, but he never responded.

Overall, Dr. Wang is a great and enthusiastic professor. Although the lectures are boring, he provides pretty good practice problems and is quick at answering emails. Furthermore, he provides organized and detailed lecture notes (which he writes in LaTex). Furthermore, homework problems and practice problems help you prepare for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His lectures are pretty hard to follow since he is just writing on the whiteboard every class, but his online notes have been a great help to understanding the material and performing well on exams. He overall means well but doesn't know how to reach his students.

Went to him several times for help on improving my exam grades and his advice was always to "study harder" although when I told him I'd studied the entire chapter top to bottom for more than 10 hours, and had the notes to show for it, he had nothing to say.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He was my favorite prof this semester. He's a very lenient grader on exams, and knows his stuff for lectures. The quizzes were very similar to stuff from the homework. Just make sure that you're doing the HW as the lectures go on, since it's pretty easy to fall behind (because he leaves them open for 2 weeks) and you should be good.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is super laid back and funny guy. He grades very leniently and quizzes are open note. Just do your homework and you'll be fine. He's also very easy to access out of class.
Solid professor, quizzes are pretty easy, grades tests pretty leniently, teaches pretty well, knows his stuff. Would recommend taking. Had some good laughs in that class too.
